invariants.statement: The repository itself remains the Genesis bootstrap surface; no separate bootstrap authority tree is introduced.
FS0-GENESIS remains intact as the historical functional set and Plan after accepted state is established.
Persistent accepted normative authority is repository-level state and is not semantically owned by the historical Plan that introduced it.
Genesis authority does not depend on prototype-repository provenance, branch ancestry, or an external source revision.
Internal accepted-state revision binding is permitted and required for normal successor framework Planning.
Design owns semantics, Planning owns normative distillation and implementation intent, and Build owns implementation correctness.
Governance, Conformance, and Assurance remain distinct authority-bearing keystones.
Conformance applicability and Assurance applicability are independent dimensions stored once with accepted normative authority.
Each Conformance assertion has exactly one normative owner; implementation may be shared.
File realization planning does not determine which normative assertions execute.
repo/scripts/validate is the sole public canonical repository Conformance entry point and contains no independent normative semantics.
Genesis implements only the framework substrate required for self-hosted successor framework development; later proposal capabilities remain eligible for later functional sets.
The initializer is a product and is not implemented by FS0-GENESIS.
FS0-CORE is a product-root concept and is not used as the framework Genesis root.
